# Shrinath Prabhu - shrinath.me

> Senior Staff Frontend Engineer with 8+ years of experience. Currently at Avail Project. Previously led frontend at Arcana Network (4.5 years, through acquisition).

Available for full-time remote roles (Senior/Staff Frontend Engineer, Technical Lead, Engineering Manager), fractional engagements (20–30 hours/week), and technical advisory. Interested in AI, SaaS, developer tools, fintech, and Web3. Core stack: Vue 3, Nuxt 3, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Chrome Extensions (Manifest V3), and Web3 (non-custodial wallets, cross-chain bridging, chain abstraction).

## Optional

- [Avail Project](https://availproject.org): Current employer; leading frontend across the Nexus product ecosystem (Fastbridge, Avail Widgets, Widget Configurator).
- [Avail Widgets](https://docs.availproject.org/docs/nexus/widgets): Prebuilt React components for cross-chain swap, send, and deposit, shipped as the npm package `@avail-project/widgets` and a shadcn registry (github.com/availproject/widgets), used by 10+ dApps. Formerly Nexus One / Nexus Elements.
- [Widget Configurator](https://widgets.availproject.org): Live playground to explore Avail Widgets settings and get the exact code to use.
